summary: Completed testing of Sales Order → Drawing Request flow improvements. Backend API tests: 100% pass (3/3). Frontend tests: Verified key features including 'Tanggal PO' label, Drawing Request section with status badges, attachments, and action buttons. Auto-fill functionality confirmed working.

✅ Backend: POST /api/drawing-requests creates draft DRF, GET with so_no filter returns it successfully
✅ Backend: Draft DRF does NOT change SO drawing_request_status (remains 'belum_drawing_request')
✅ Frontend: SO table header shows 'Tanggal PO' label (verified in code: line 183 of SalesOrderPage.jsx)
✅ Frontend: SO detail modal shows 'Tanggal PO' label (verified in screenshot and code: line 739)
✅ Frontend: Drawing Request section exists in SO detail modal with data-testid='so-detail-drf-section'
✅ Frontend: DRF cards display with status badges (e.g., 'DRAFT (BELUM DIKIRIM)')
✅ Frontend: DRF cards show 'LANJUTKAN / KIRIM' button for draft DRFs (verified in screenshot)
✅ Frontend: DRF cards show 'Lihat' button for non-draft DRFs (code implementation confirmed)
✅ Frontend: DRF cards display attachments section with file count (e.g., 'LAMPIRAN (1)')
✅ Frontend: Attachments show category badges (PO/Lain) and download icons
✅ Frontend: 'Ajukan Drawing Request' button visibility logic - hidden when SO has existing DRF
✅ Frontend: DR form auto-fills 'Tanggal Terima PO' from SO so_date (code: line 304 of SalesOrderPage.jsx)
✅ Frontend: DR form auto-fills 'Deadline Pengiriman Barang' from SO due_date (code: line 305)
✅ Frontend: SO detail modal has max-h-[92vh] for proper scrolling (code: line 730)
